data.source: Pinterest production API v5 public-pin metrics plus GA4 and first-party database acquisition checks
caveats: Captured about 25 seconds after production publication as a receipt baseline, not a performance verdict.

The bounded experiment now has five Arm A clean Pins and six Arm B headline Pins. Arm B has one total public impression and Arm A has zero, with no format-cohort save, Pin click, outbound click, attributable site session, or downstream product click.

The full truthful public profile measured 262 impressions, two Pin clicks, one save, and zero outbound clicks immediately after publication; all historic engagement remains on the older corrected-goat Pin.

GA4 recorded 14 trailing-seven-day sessions from Direct or Amazon Organic Shopping and no Pinterest source or product_click/affiliate_click row. The first-party database recorded zero product clicks and searches in 24 hours and seven days.
Pinterest v3 and Sandbox are excluded. Revenue remains unavailable and is null.
